title: UI round 3: Home and the run control (three buttons, facts not estimates, waiting on you first)
description:
## Why

LIN-4024 made Home work with a real backlog, and it's a big improvement. This is the next round of feedback, agreed with John on 30 Oct. It covers how Harbour works for the person using it (what Home is for, and what the big button does) and how it looks (less clutter, more intuitive).

**Since this was written** (main at 27ae64ad): the code rounds have landed. A task's state has one owner, `lib/task-state.js` (LIN-4016), and since Tidy 4 (LIN-4068) one set of facts: Home's rows, the opened box, `/state`, the task page and the share page all read the same gather over the workspace's issue set (`gatherTaskStates` in `lib/home-row-states.js`, held by `lib/task-facts-holder.js`, with every level of subtask from `lib/subtree-index.js`). The browser reads the server's decided action and holds no state rules of its own, and `deriveHeader` only writes the sentence (LIN-4071). A parent counts a running or queued subtask as busy; check item 4 against that rather than assuming it's met. A parent's next subtask is decided in one place, `parentNextOf` (LIN-4039), and a row's "next" words in `nextWordsOf`. The CSS has one token set (LIN-4015). The question card shows only for an open ruling (LIN-4038). A finished task offers no run (LIN-4042). Build on these rather than beside them.

## The feedback

All of it is in `docs/reviews/ui-feedback-round-3-2026-10-30/README.md` (on main since PR #2189): 25 numbered items, each saying what is wrong now and what is wanted, with labelled screenshots. Read it first. It says what to reach, not how to build it, except where John has ruled on the behaviour (marked **John**).

In short:

1. **Running a task (items 1–6).**
   * Three buttons, by how far to go: Next step, Run to PR, Run to Done. They are ordered by trust. The filled one is the one last used on this workspace, and "Next step" on a workspace that has never run anything (John).
   * "Next step" is decided at run time by the existing recommend call and shown with a confirm before it runs. Never name a step in advance, and don't build a second system to guess it.
   * "Run to PR" and "Run to Done" say what Harbour picked once that is known.
   * Never offer a run that would collide with one in flight. While a subtask waits on you, lead with its question, not a run.
2. **Facts, not estimates (7–9).**
   * The stage strip and the rows show what actually ran. "Research next" on tasks that have never run goes.
   * One word for a failure, and the count line, badge, rows and opened box all agree.
3. **What needs you (10–12).**
   * "Waiting on you" comes first on Home, one card per question, answered in place, with the recommended answer as the main button.
   * A parent shows all its children's questions.
   * Item 12 is a note for the autopilot side: ask fewer questions.
4. **What Home is (13–14).**
   * Three sections: Waiting on you, Running and recently moved, Up next.
   * The full backlog moves to its own page.
5. **The UI finish (15–25).**
   * One state line, and plain words instead of machine words.
   * The Sessions list agrees with the box.
   * Ruling options are real buttons, and the Change drawer gets room.
   * The task page puts the ruling first.
   * Normal type sizes on a phone, about four sizes in all, and mono only for facts.
   * One control line per project section, and a trimmed view bar.
6. **A set halt (added 1 Nov).** When the workspace's dispatch is paused or stopped, Home says so and points to where it's cleared. Today it shows only on the Dispatch page and in Settings, so John set a stop and couldn't see it from Home.

## Open for John

* **Which views stay in the view bar.** Keep today's bar until he says. *Answered 3 Nov 2026 (ruling* `lin4040-view-bar`*): keep today's bar; item 25 is closed with no change.*

## How to check

Use a workspace shaped like the real one: thousands of tasks, parents with subtasks, a few rulings open, and a parent with a subtask running. Check at 1280px and 390px, light and dark, for the runner owner and a new user without a runner. A copy of the real backlog from 29 Oct exists, with a loader. Ask in this ticket if you want it committed.

This can be split into subtasks along the doc's groups. Items 6 and 12 can be their own follow-ups.

## Done when

* Every item in the doc is reached, or answered in the PR with a reason, and shown in screenshots at both widths.
* "Next step" shows the step the recommend call chose, with a confirm, before anything runs.
* The count line, the header badge, each row and each opened box agree, including for a parent with a running or failed subtask.
* A paused or stopped workspace says so on Home.
* `ci-success` is green, and E2E specs go through `tests/fixtures/local-harness.js` and `SELECTORS`.

## Implementation Plan

*Pruned at close-out (3 Nov 2026). The plan was implemented as approved (Plan Review Verdict Approve, 1 Nov), as five slices: S1 LIN-4103 (#2224), S2 LIN-4104 (#2225), S3 LIN-4105 (#2226–#2251), S4 LIN-4106 (#2254), S5 LIN-4107 (#2256). Deviations are recorded on the slice tickets and in the comments (S1 grep classification; S2 known limit; S4's four deviations). The review's close-out fixes landed in PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2257](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2257>) (merge* `ff1f4aa5`*). The full pre-prune description is preserved in the task snapshots, and the plan, plan reviews and close-out summary are in the comment trail.*

### Left out, with the ticket that handles it

* Collision refusal on the server: LIN-4054. Track record under the buttons (item 6): LIN-4055. Fewer autopilot questions (item 12): LIN-4056. LIN-4044 (a row naming a child the seed skips) should close as moot once slice 1 removes the row's named child; the slice-1 builder confirms and says so on that ticket.
* "Since you last looked" (item 13's tail): needs a per-viewer last-seen; the slice-3 builder files it as a follow-up, related to this ticket.
* Item 25's view bar: unchanged until John says which views stay.
* `truncated` (Jira and GitHub Projects only; Linear paginates) leaves the held set cold, so those workspaces get no offer; say so in the PR so it is not read as a Linear gap.

Plan settles: shape, the offer vocabulary, where "last used" comes from, the Next step flow, the order. Left to the builder: exact words, the Up next cap if 5 reads wrong on the real backlog, CSS values, the index if the query needs one.

**Research notes, 30 Oct (LinearViewer main at `46fe95f5`).**

## Re-ground

The ticket was filed at 11:06Z. Eight commits have landed since (#2189 to #2195: LIN-4016, 4039, 4015, 4038, 4042, 4037, 4036 and the feedback doc). The ticket's "Since this was written" note already names all of them, and HEAD is `46fe95f5`, the sha it cites. I re-read the cited seams at HEAD: `lib/task-state.js`, `lib/task-page-loader.js` (`sessionSummaryOf`, `buildRowStates`, `loadTaskState`), `routes/task-page.js` (`/state`) and `public/prompt-section.js` (`renderGo`, `startRun`). Nothing in the ticket's description of the code is stale.

## Per-layer audit

### L1. The task's state owner (`lib/task-state.js`)
- `taskStateOf` decides each row. The precedence is: needs you > failed > running > queued > parked > the tracker's word > next (`task-state.js:207-268`).
- `rollUpRow` rolls a parent's children into its row (`:138-149`).
- `mainActionOf` returns null when busy, Run to PR for a container, and otherwise the offered step (`:281-285`).
- `next` is the **guess**, `model.guesses[0]` (`:97`). That is the source of "Research next" (item 8).
- The parent's line words "A subtask needs you" or "A subtask failed" (`attentionOf`, `:178-183`). Item 9's two words for one failure come from here.
- **Must hold:** one decision for the row, the count line, `/state` and the opened box, so new states land here, never beside it.

### L2. The opened box's read (`/state`, `routes/task-page.js:177-221` → `loadTaskState`, `task-page-loader.js:1403-1415`)
- It reads only the task's **own** loops (`getLoopsForIssue(urlKey, identifier)`), and returns no tracker word.
- `sessionSummaryOf` (`task-page-loader.js:987-1024`) computes `busy` from its own sessions only. The only fact it gets about subtasks is `container=1`, passed back by the page (`prompt-section.js:2042`).
- **This is the confirmed cause of item 4.** The row (via `rollUpRow`) knows a subtask runs or waits on you; the box does not. So it offers Run to PR next to "A subtask needs you".
- **LIN-4048 is the same class:** `/state` has no tracker, so `mainActionOf` can't see "finished". LIN-4042 patched Home in the browser (`row.finished`, `prompt-section.js:634, 1506`); the task page still offers a run.
- **Must hold:** LIN-4016's "the server decides, the browser follows". It must also stay a stored-data read, because it is polled.

### L3. The run control client (`public/prompt-section.js`)
- `renderGo` (`:276-344`) draws one main button: `Run <Stage>` (`run-step-next` → `runStepNow`, `:1529-1564`) or `Run to PR` (`go` → `startRun`, `:2131-2199`).
- `startRun` always sends `stopAt: 'pr'` (`:2152, 2175`).
- `runStepNow` dispatches on the opened issue only, with no live re-check at press time (`:1527-1528`). Only `startRun` re-reads `/state` (`:2142`).
- The step line names "Run to PR · the next step for this task" (`renderStepLine`, `:1159-1174`). Those are item 2's two answers.
- Surfaces: `home`, `task` and `swipe` (`SURFACE_CAPABILITIES`, `:259-264`). Swipe uses the plain "Go" branch (`:325`), which also stops at PR.
- Copy-first: `renderCopyIdle` (`:551-562`) names the step in advance from `COPY_STEPS` (`task-board-view.js:205-208`). That is item 5.

### L4. The recommend call (what "Next step" must use)
- `GET /workspace/:urlKey/api/recommend/:issueId` (`routes/workspace-api.js:400-510`), plus its SSE twin (`:526-593`).
- It descends through `resolveRecommendation` (`lib/recommend-recurse.js:107-222`, up to 10 defer hops). It returns `{reasoning, prompt, identifier (the terminal subtask), deferredVia, …}` (`:487-498`).
- **The stage is not a field there.** The proxy twin already adds `recommendedAction` and `kind` (`routes/proxy-compute.js:525-534`), and the parsers exist (`parseRecommendedAction` and `parseWhyNow`, `lib/stage-router.js:37-61`). Adding the same fields to the workspace route is additive. Existing clients read only `reasoning` and `prompt`.
- **Cost:** one LLM call per hop (`getRecommendation`, `lib/openrouter.js:1941-2056`), 120s timeout per hop, 180s budget for the descent. Nothing is cached. On the free tier it is charged to the hourly prompt allowance (`workspace-api.js:425-430`).
- The reply already holds the full stage prompt, so a confirmed Next step dispatches **that prompt**. There is no second fetch and no second decision.
- `POST /api/dispatch` takes `issueIdentifier` without `issueId` (`lib/dispatch-entrance.js:173-176, 256`), so dispatching to the recommended subtask works.

### L5. Run to PR / Run to Done (autopilot)
- `stopAt: 'pr'` is the only value accepted (`lib/dispatch-fields.js:141, 198`; `routes/workspace-api-prompts.js:313-320`). It is enforced by `guardCloseOut` (`lib/dispatch-factory.js:388`) and inherited by child autopilots (`dispatch-entrance.js:1729-1739`).
- **Run to Done already exists:** leave `stopAt` out, and the kickoff ends with the close-out (`lib/prompts/autopilot-kickoff.js:555+`). On the row, though, "done" can't be told apart from other launchers' null.
- **What it picked:** every worker carries `sessionId = <autopilot dispatch id>` (`dispatch-fields.js:113-116`, `dispatch-store.js:226-240`). The worker's `issueIdentifier` is the subtask and its `kind` is the stage (`dispatch-entrance.js:1661-1704`). So "started with Research on LIN-4011" is the first worker row with that `sessionId`.
- No session-auth JSON read returns that today. `dispatchStore.listHistory` takes `sessionId` (`dispatch-store.js:262`), but `/state` and `GET /api/dispatch` don't use it.

### L6. "Last used on this workspace"
- `TaskModeStore` (`lib/task-mode-store.js`) is the existing record of which way a person took a task. It holds per-account events `{urlKey, issueIdentifier, rung: copy|run-step|run-task, act, dispatchId, surface, at}` (`:26-40`). The server writes it on every ladder dispatch (`routes/dispatch.js:492-516`) and the client writes it for presses (`prompt-section.js:1790-1807`).
- It has no PR/Done distinction and no "latest for this workspace" query (`getTaskMode` is per task, `:241-254`).
- `UserPreferences` is keyed by account and `WorkspacePreferences` by workspace; neither is per person per workspace.
- **Must hold:** extend the task-mode log (it is the ladder record, and the ladder is what item 1 implements). Do not add a preference.

### L7. Home's structure (`server.js:3406-3491`, `lib/home-view.js`, `lib/render.js:225-452`)
- **Sections today:** count line, In Progress (`orderInProgress` by rank), Recent activity (folded), then one section per project.
- Recent activity is `buildRecentActivityForest(issues, projects, 1)` (`server.js:1863`). It is built from **tracker timestamps** (created, edited, completed), not runs. It is uncapped, not trimmed by `buildHomeView` (`server.js:3441` passes it raw), and every row is rendered hidden (`render.js:381`). That is why it repeats In Progress.
- It is almost certainly also most of the "~3,700 hidden rows / 5.1 MB" in the doc's "Not ours" note. The local store stamps `createdAt: now` on an import with no date (`lib/local-store.js:123`), so a copied backlog lands entirely in a one-day window. Item 13 removes the cause.
- **No "since you last looked" state exists anywhere.** There is no per-user last-visit field (`user-preferences.js:264-410`), and Home's localStorage holds only collapse state.
- **No backlog page exists.** The reusable parts are `renderPage`/`renderProject` over untrimmed `trees` (the pre-LIN-4024 board, still used by the landing page, `server.js:2336`) and `/api/home-rows`'s `backlog` paging (`lib/home-rows.js`).
- The four trailing project lines are at `render.js:412-450` (testids `home-fold-up-next`, `create-task`, `home-fold-backlog` and `home-done-count`).
- **The view bar:** `getViewNavLinks` (`lib/components/view-nav.js:64-101`). It stays as it is (John).

### L8. Rulings: the card, the count and the badge
- **One card renderer:** `renderQuestionCard` (`lib/question-card.js:36-98`). It serves the task page (`render-task-page.js:791-813`), Home's opened box (`questionHtml` on `/state`) and the run page (`render-session.js:515`).
- It draws radio rows, a mono textarea and a small "Answer" button.
- **`decision.recommended` exists in the data** (`lib/session-telemetry.js:670, 693-694`), but the card never reads it. Observation's ChatUI does (`public/observation.js:2391`).
- **The count line and the badge do NOT share one read:**
  - The count line is `rulingCount` from `readRulingStanding` for this workspace (`lib/home-row-states.js:65`, `lib/ruling-standing.js:27-39`).
  - The badge is `GET /api/dashboard/rulings`. It counts every workspace in the session and passes `liveDispatchOnAnchor` (`routes/dashboard-rulings.js:94-114`). `readRulingStanding` does not.
  - The two agree in the single-workspace E2E fixture (`lin-4024-home-seeded.spec.js:92-113`), and can differ outside it. Item 9's "every count agrees" isn't actually guaranteed today.

### L9. Facts, not estimates: the stage strip, rows, Last line and Sessions list
- **Two stage renderers over one model:**
  - `renderStageStrip` (Home, `render-task-page.js:427-443`): "next" or "usual" chips.
  - `renderTaskTrack` (task page, `:388-397`): hard-coded "usually next" (`:374-377`).
  - Both append `guessStages` as `ahead` rows (`buildTaskStages`, `task-page-loader.js:513-523`).
  - `breakdown` isn't in `USUAL_STAGES` (`run-view.js:43`), so a broken-down parent shows "Build next".
- **Last line** (`renderLastLine`, `prompt-section.js:983-991`): raw session state words ("queued", "closed"), "Check-in" for wake, and `All N` counts check-ins too.
- **Sessions list (item 17) is a second state model.**
  - `GET /api/sessions/:identifier` (`routes/workspace-api-run-evidence.js:74-112`) projects `toSessionView`, whose state is `_deriveAgentState` (`lib/pipeline-loops.js:144-152`): any loop that isn't live, blocked or ended reads `running`.
  - The box reads `toSession` (`task-page-loader.js:263-269`), where waiting comes from `deriveSessionWaiting`.
  - The list also doesn't file orchestration rows (autopilot, wake, custom, periodical) as check-ins (the model does, `task-page-loader.js:453-474`). That is where "autopilot · queued" and "Prompt · queued" come from.
  - The route **already calls `loadTaskState`**, but only to read `parked` (`:94-103`).
- **One state line (item 15):** the task page has `Tracker:` (`render-task-page.js:178-183`) plus `Harbour:` (`:193-206`). Home's `renderHomeStatus` returns '' for idle-with-no-sessions and for running (`:223-245`). The client blanks its own line when a subtask line shows (`prompt-section.js:955-956`).
- **Task page order (item 20):** answer, run control, chat, ruling card, stages (`render-task-page.js:961-975`).

### L10. Type and mono (items 21-23)
- The only size tokens are `--font-size-sm/base/lg` (`public/style.css:102-105`).
- **The cause of item 21 is the body shrink:** 14px at ≤640px (`style.css:2455-2458`) and 13px at ≤400px (`:2727-2731`). Every `em` rule scales down with it (0.8em × 13 = 10.4px).
- Roughly 30 distinct size values across `style.css`, `run-control.css`, `stage-track.css`, `task-page.css` and `session.css`.
- Mono on non-facts: ruling options and the answer box (`session.css:113, 126`), the Sessions fold (`style.css:5094-5097`), and `.opened-task-generated` (`run-control.css:332`).
- A test pins 12px: `tests/unit/lin-4024-type-floor.test.js:17-47`.

### L11. Tests
- **E2E on Home:** `lin-4024-home-folds`, `lin-4024-home-seeded`, `lin-3968-home-next-step`, `lin-4010-home-opened-task`, `lin-3833-home-first-page`, `lin-3968-home-polish`, `lin-4009-shared-look`, `opened-task-first-screen`, `dashboard`, `dashboard-empty-project-collapse`, `header-nav`, `tree-sections`, `interactions` and `search`.
- `SELECTORS` in `tests/helpers.js` covers only `project`/`issue` for Home (`:194-196`). The new sections need entries there.
- **Unit tests pinning wording that changes:** `lin-4024-task-state` ("Research next"), `lin-3833-row-states`, `lin-4039-parent-next`, `lin-3968-home-polish` ("usual" ×5), `render-task-page-golden` ("usually next"), `lin-4010-home-opened-task` (six chips, the Last line), `lin-3975-task-run-control` (`Tracker:`/`Harbour:`), `task-page-question` (radio `:checked`) and `lin-4024-type-floor` (12px).

## Classes

1. **Places that offer a run** (bounded by grepping `opened-task-go`, `data-action="go"`, `run-step-next`, `startRun` and `fetchAutopilotKickoff` in `public/`):
   - `renderGo` on `home`, `task` and `swipe`
   - `renderStepLine`
   - the "Another step" list (`run-pick`)
   - `renderCopyIdle` (copy-first)
   - the old Swipe ladder `renderLadder` (`run this step`) and the autopilot buttons (`:467-469`)

   All of them must obey "no run that collides" and "finished offers none".
2. **Readers of the guess** (`guessStages`, `model.guesses`, `nextStepOf`, `taskFactsOf.next`; bounded by grep):
   - `taskFactsOf.next` → row "next" state and `nextWordsOf`
   - `sessionSummaryOf.next`/`offered`
   - `renderStageStrip`/`stripWord`
   - `renderTaskTrack`/`renderAheadStage`
   - `buildTaskStages`
   - `mainActionOf`'s `offered`
   - `containerFocusOf` (row next for parents)
   - the idle sentence "Last: …" (`task-page-loader.js:667`)
   - Item 7/8 turns every display reader off. **Kept:** `newestFailed` (the failed fact) and `excluded` (the Another step list).
3. **Surfaces that say a task's state** (bounded by L1/L8/L9):
   - row (`render.js:675`)
   - count line (`buildInProgressCountParts`)
   - header badge (`/api/dashboard/rulings`)
   - opened-box pill and line (`renderHomeStatus`)
   - task page `Harbour:` line
   - subtask attention line
   - Sessions list
   - Last line
   - stage strip/track

   Two of these don't read `taskStateOf`: **the badge and the Sessions list**.
4. **Ruling renderers** (bounded by grepping for the `decision.options` readers):
   - `lib/question-card.js` (task page, Home box, run page): in scope for item 18
   - Observation ChatUI (`public/observation.js:2391`)
   - Flight Companion
   - `public/scan.js:148`

   The last three are out of scope; they are not Home or the run control.
5. **Readers of "what is next for a parent"** (`parentNextOf`): rows via `containerFocusOf`, `recommend-recurse`, `prompt-formatters` and the three providers. Once rows stop naming a step (item 8), **only the prompt seed and the descent read it, and LIN-4044 (row versus seed disagreement) has no row left to disagree. It can close as moot.**
6. **Production population (unbounded from source):** how many open rulings carry `recommended`, and how often the badge's cross-workspace count differs from Home's. This is production data. It is checkable with the 29 Oct backlog copy plus the ruling store, not from source.

## Closing the set

Searches that would have turned up a missed sibling:
- I grepped for every consumer of the task-state exports (`mainActionOf|parentNextOf|nextWordsOf|rollUpRow|taskStateOf|taskFactsOf|sessionFactsOf`). The hits were `task-page-loader`, `home-view`, `render-task-page`, `routes/task-page`, `task-board-view`, `prompt-section` and the `parentNextOf` set above; nothing else.
- I grepped for `recommended` in `lib/question-card.js` and found nothing.
- I grepped for every `stopAt` writer. Only `startRun` and the ladder's `fetchPrompt('__autopilot__')` write it, both with `'pr'`.

What I didn't verify:
- Flight Companion's ruling card, and whether `public/scan.js` reads `recommended`.
- The landing page's product glimpses, which may show the old run button (`render-landing.js`).

For the set to be wrong, a surface outside `public/prompt-section.js` would have to start a run on Home. `public/app.js:318-351` mounts only PromptSection, so I don't believe one does.

## Options for the run control

- **(a) Next step = `recommend` (non-stream) → confirm card → dispatch `rec.prompt` to `rec.identifier`.** It is the existing call, the existing prompt, and one decision. Cost: one LLM routing call per press (seconds; up to 120s per hop), charged to the hourly prompt allowance on the free tier. The confirm must say "deciding…" while it waits, and offer Cancel. **Recommended.**
- (b) Next step = the SSE stream (`/recommend/:id/stream`), already used by ✦ write prompt. It shows progress, but the stage still has to be parsed out of `reasoning` on the client. Use it only if the wait proves too long. It needs the same additive `done` fields.
- (c) Keep the estimate (`nextStepOf`) and add a confirm. Rejected by John's ruling.

## Options for the parent box (item 4)

- **(a) `/state` takes the subtree as the page's own fact**, as `container=1` does today (Home has the tree in `rowData`; the task page has `ctx.children`). It reads those tasks' loops and returns a rolled-up `taskState` (`rollUpRow`) plus a decided `actions` list. **Recommended.** It keeps "the server decides". The cost is one extra loop read per subtask per poll, for containers only.
- (b) The browser combines `row.attention`/`row.state` with its own `/state`. That is LIN-4042's patch shape, and it brings back a browser-side decision that LIN-4016 removed. Rejected.
- (c) `/state` reads the tracker for children. That puts a provider call into a 5s poll. Rejected.

## Surface Assessment

`Surface Assessment: [refactor required: R1, "/state decides the opened box over the task's subtree": loadTaskState takes the subtree identifiers the page passes back (like container=1) plus a finished flag, reads their loops, returns rollUpRow's state and replaces mainActionOf with an actions decision over that rolled-up state (none while anything in the subtree runs or needs you; none when finished) — reason: removes item 4's confirmed cause (sessionSummaryOf/loadTaskState read own loops only, task-page-loader.js:987-1024, 1403-1415) and LIN-4048's (no finished fact in /state). R2, "the Sessions fold reads the task model's sessions": /api/sessions projects loadTaskState's model.sessions (states and check-in filing from toSession/groupSessions) instead of toSessionView's _deriveAgentState — reason: removes item 17's cause, a second session-state model (pipeline-loops.js:144-152 vs task-page-loader.js:263-269)]`

**Who pays.**
- **R1:**
  - Beneficiaries: Home's box and the task page (corrected), and LIN-4042's browser patch (`prompt-section.js:634, 1506`), which can be deleted.
  - Leaf tasks: unchanged, since no subtree is passed.
  - The bystander tax is one loop read per subtask per `/state` poll, on containers only. A small, named tax for a correctness fix.
  - Swipe: unchanged (`runControl: false`).
  - The Sessions route's `loadTaskState` call passes no subtree, so it is unchanged.
- **R2:**
  - Beneficiaries: the Sessions fold (corrected).
